title: Giant Sequoia: Ancient Sequoias You Can Visit
meta_description: The largest living things on earth, in Europe barely 170 years old and already enormous. The biggest sequoias mapped so far, from botanic gardens to parks.
intro: The heaviest living things on earth reached Europe only in 1853, and the timing shaped everything: Victorian Britain was at peak plant mania, and a tree that could outweigh a blue whale sold itself. Nurserymen shipped seeds by the ton, aristocrats raced to plant avenues of them, and the British even named the species Wellingtonia after the recently dead duke, a name Californians never accepted. Every sequoia outside America is therefore young, barely 170 years at most, yet many already dominate their skylines, because the species grows fast and simply does not stop: in the Sierra Nevada they pass 3,000 years and eighty metres. The sequoias mapped so far are Europe's biggest infants, largest and oldest first.
